ui.carryLabel: Unsent verdicts from a closed run
ui.carrySummaryMany: {count} verdicts recorded in {runs} never reached the server
ui.carrySummaryOne: 1 verdict recorded in {runs} never reached the server
ui.carryWhere: Nothing can be written back to {runs}. Send them to {target}, which records them as part of that run, or keep them here and decide later.

ADM-012.scenario: Full review decision path completes with actions visible
preconditions: Steward session; at least one pending submission in the selected garden
steps: Open /hub/work
Open a pending submission
Inspect evidence media
Choose a confidence level (none is chosen at first) and enter feedback
Verify Approve and Reject are visible in the pinned dialog action region without scrolling
Approve, or press Reject and give a reason in the Reject Work dialog
Confirm the queue updates
ADM-012.expected: The complete decision path works and commit/cancel actions are never hidden inside a clipped scrolling region

ADM-145.scenario: Confirm Kept… reviews the commitment before confirming it
preconditions: Steward with the garden that confirms the commitment selected in the header
A commitment waiting for that garden's confirmation and marked Ready to confirm; the confirming account is not a contributor
steps: Open Hub → Confirm and press Confirm Kept… on the commitment's row
Read the review
Press Confirm Kept and confirm in the wallet
Read Hub → Confirm and the commitment afterwards
ADM-145.expected: Before anything is sent, the review names the commitment, the garden's pool it lives in, and who kept it, and says either that this confirmation closes it as kept for everyone or which confirmation of how many it is, and that it cannot be undone; confirming is one transaction; the commitment then reads Kept and leaves the queue, or its row shows one more confirmation

ADM-014.scenario: Pool console statuses, seeding, and detail are coherent
preconditions: Steward session; garden with a pool
steps: Open /garden/pool
Inspect funding and readiness status
Open /garden/pool/seed and review before any commit
Open a commitment detail
Cancel out safely
ADM-014.expected: Statuses are honest, destructive/chain actions are gated behind review, and cancel preserves state

ADM-140.scenario: Seed a commitment: 4-step wizard, named confirmers, review before sending
preconditions: Garden pool open; the separate local garden commitment names an independent garden steward or evaluator as confirmer, never its contributor
steps: Run the 4-step seed wizard
Add named confirmers incl. one bad address
Review, press Seed This Commitment, and confirm in the wallet, then press Done and verify the wizard closes
ADM-140.expected: Each step validates before Next; a bad or duplicate confirmer address is rejected visibly; the review reads every answer back before anything is sent; seeding asks the wallet to confirm one creation, and the wizard shows it as Created until Done closes it

ADM-037.scenario: Record a starting assessment for the test garden
preconditions: Signed in with Tester A's allowlisted wallet
Tester A can evaluate the test garden
steps: Select the test garden and start a new assessment
Record the garden's starting context with enough detail for Tester B to recognize it
Review and submit the assessment
Wait for the submitted assessment to appear on the garden
ADM-037.expected: The assessment is recorded against the test garden and is visible as starting context, without being described as a prerequisite for opening a Season or Campaign

PWA-046.scenario: Garden member can read the starting assessment
preconditions: Signed in with Tester B's allowlisted wallet
Tester B is a member of the test garden
ADM-037 is complete
steps: Open the test garden
Open its assessment history
Find the starting assessment recorded by Tester A
Read enough detail to confirm it belongs to this QA cycle
PWA-046.expected: The same starting assessment is readable from the garden experience and is presented as context, not as a gate on the cycle

ADM-038.scenario: Open the test Season and Campaign independently of assessment state
preconditions: Signed in with Tester A's allowlisted wallet
Tester A is a steward of the test garden
The test garden commitment pool is ready
steps: Open the test garden's pool setup
Create or select the QA Season
Open one Campaign for the commitment relay
Confirm the open cycle is visible before seeding commitments
ADM-038.expected: The Season and Campaign open successfully whether or not the starting assessment has finished indexing; the assessment remains contextual

ADM-139.scenario: Seed an approval-gated protocol Request for garden work the test garden can deliver
preconditions: Signed in with Tester A's allowlisted wallet
Tester A is a protocol steward
The protocol pool has an open cycle
steps: Open the Green Goods protocol pool
Seed a Request of the Garden work (impact) type with one action row the test garden can submit Work for
Keep claim mode on Steward-reviewed so a claimant must be accepted
Review and seed the Request, confirming in the wallet
Wait for the Request to appear in the protocol pool
ADM-139.expected: One steward-reviewed Request appears in the protocol pool with its action row, target, and confirmation expectations intact. It is the garden-work type, so it becomes ready through approved linked Work, not through evidence and Send for Confirmation

PWA-047.scenario: Claim the protocol Request for the test garden
preconditions: Signed in with Tester B's allowlisted wallet
Tester B is a steward of the test garden
ADM-139 is complete
steps: Open the protocol Request
Choose to take it up for the test garden
Review the garden identity and submit the claim
Wait for the claim to show as pending approval
PWA-047.expected: The claim is pending for the test garden; it is not presented as a personal claim and the Request has not moved out of the protocol pool

ADM-040.scenario: Accept the test garden's institutional claim
preconditions: Signed in with Tester A's allowlisted wallet
Tester A is a protocol steward
PWA-047 is complete
steps: Open pending claims for the protocol Request
Identify the claim from the test garden
Accept the garden claim
Reopen the Request after the state updates
ADM-040.expected: The claim becomes Accepted, the garden is the institutional provider, and the original Request remains in the protocol pool

PWA-048.scenario: Submit Work and evidence against the original protocol Request
preconditions: Signed in with Tester B's allowlisted wallet
Tester B is the accountable lead and a contributor for the test garden
ADM-040 is complete
steps: Open the Accepted protocol Request
Start or link the Work completed for the service
Add clear evidence from Tester B
Submit the Work
Return to the Request and verify the Work is linked
PWA-048.expected: Tester B's Work and evidence link to the original protocol-pool Request while the test garden remains the accountable provider

ADM-041.scenario: Approve Work linked to the protocol Request without joining its contributors
preconditions: Signed in with Tester A's allowlisted wallet
Tester A can review the test garden but is not a contributor
PWA-048 is complete
steps: Open the pending Work linked to the protocol Request
Inspect Tester B's evidence and garden context
Approve the Work
Verify the review state updates without adding Tester A as a contributor
ADM-041.expected: The linked Work is approved by an independent reviewer and Tester A remains outside the contributor roster

ADM-042.scenario: Confirm the protocol Request after its Work is approved
preconditions: Signed in with Tester A's allowlisted wallet
Tester A created the protocol Request
ADM-041 is complete
steps: Open the protocol Request awaiting confirmation
Verify the approved Work and evidence are named
Confirm fulfillment as the Request creator
Reopen the Request after the state updates
ADM-042.expected: The Request becomes Fulfilled with the test garden still named as provider and Tester B's Work preserved as evidence

ADM-043.scenario: Settle earned G$ compensation from the protocol to the garden
preconditions: Signed in with Tester A's allowlisted wallet
ADM-042 is complete
The destination Garden Safe is known
steps: Open the Fulfilled protocol Request's settlement action
Verify the beneficiary is the destination Garden Safe
If settlement UI and value authority are available, review and submit the payout
Otherwise stop at the visible gate and record Blocked
Ask Tester B to verify the destination state
ADM-043.expected: When enabled, earned compensation targets the Garden Safe and the result is visible; when unavailable, the UI states the gate and no value movement is implied

PWA-049.scenario: Take up the separate local garden commitment
preconditions: Signed in with Tester B's allowlisted wallet
Tester B is a member of the test garden
ADM-140 is complete
steps: Open the test garden's current Campaign
Open the local commitment seeded for the member
Take up the commitment with Tester B's own identity
Verify its identity differs from the protocol Request
PWA-049.expected: Tester B takes up a separate Garden-pool commitment; it is neither moved from nor mirrored to the protocol pool

PWA-050.scenario: Submit Work and evidence for the local garden commitment
preconditions: Signed in with Tester B's allowlisted wallet
PWA-049 is complete
steps: Open the local garden commitment
Start or link its Work
Add evidence that identifies the local delivery
Submit the Work
Verify the Work is linked to the local commitment
PWA-050.expected: The member's Work and evidence are submitted against the separate garden commitment and are ready for independent review

ADM-044.scenario: Settle the garden's contributor payout to the member
preconditions: Signed in with Tester A's allowlisted wallet
The local garden commitment is complete
Tester B's receiving account is known
steps: Open the completed local garden commitment's payout action
Verify Tester B is the intended contributor recipient
If contributor payout UI and value authority are available, review and submit the payout
Otherwise stop at the visible gate and record Blocked
Ask Tester B to verify the receiving state
ADM-044.expected: When enabled, the garden pays the contributing member and the result is visible; when unavailable, the UI states the gate while the completed non-value workflow remains intact

ADM-045.scenario: Queue a discretionary protocol-to-garden treasury top-up
preconditions: Signed in with Tester A's allowlisted wallet
ADM-014 has confirmed funding readiness
The destination garden and amount are explicitly authorized
steps: Open the protocol treasury funding action
Choose the destination garden under Receiving garden and enter the amount
Verify no commitment is requested or attached
If value authority is available, press Review Seed or Top-Up…, read the confirmation, and press Queue Seed or Top-Up
Otherwise stop at the visible gate and record Blocked
Ask Tester B to verify the garden balance or readiness state
ADM-045.expected: When authorized and enabled, a discretionary top-up is queued for the correct garden and its balance reflects the result; it never substitutes for earned compensation or references a commitment

ADM-202.scenario: Resolve a steward request and verify confirmed cockpit access
preconditions: ADM-201 pending request
Authorized independent reviewer and requester using separate accounts
Role assignment transaction explicitly authorized
steps: Open the steward-access queue and approve the request
Wait for the role receipt and request resolution
As the requester, refresh and enter the cockpit; compare with an ordinary membership request
ADM-202.expected: Approval assigns the steward role, not ordinary membership. Access opens only after confirmed authority; a pending or failed role assignment is not reported as access granted.

QA-004.scenario: Verify catalog revision and distinguish regression from rollout results
preconditions: A QA deployment with the intended catalog revision; known build identifiers
Required participants: allowlisted QA tester.
steps: Compare the deployed revision with the catalog being reviewed and record the product builds
Select a normal surface, then Rollout Readiness and an In progress journey
Read the private run report by surface and inspect retired IDs
QA-004.expected: The run identifies the exact catalog and builds. Rollout cases are visibly separate and are not treated as proof of shipped behavior; retired IDs retain history but cannot be walked.

ROLL-006.scenario: In progress: apply delayed policy and recover a paused jar safely
preconditions: Activation gate: use only the explicitly scoped rollout build and reviewed deployment; this case is not evidence that the feature has shipped.
Reviewed Hats jar pair and authorized governor; disposable balance and approved recovery destination
Required participants: owner and steward.
steps: Propose a policy, try early execution, cancel it and propose a replacement
Apply after the delay and reject the stale proposal
Pause and test claim refusal; verify separate unpause and recovery authority and reject the wrong recovery recipient
ROLL-006.expected: Only the current policy executes after its delay. Pause blocks claims; unpause and recovery require their designated authority. Recovery uses only the approved destination and uncertain receipts are checked before retrying.

AGT-001.scenario: Consent and pair a Telegram reporter with the intended account
preconditions: Enabled Telegram reporting channel in the selected environment
Disposable conversation and member account; consent to private test media
Required participants: reporter.
steps: Start reporting and read the consent and account link
Decline once; restart and open the link with the intended account
Complete account proof and return to the conversation
AGT-001.expected: Declining records no report. Pairing binds only the proven account and intended conversation; it grants no unrelated garden role.

PWA-141.scenario: Receive a delivered service and reconcile held, spent and returned vouchers
preconditions: Enabled service-voucher deployment and a test service with agreed terms
Member and independent steward; test funds and the write boundary explicitly authorized
A booking whose delivery the independent steward can resolve
steps: Record the held and available amounts
Have the steward complete the agreed delivery, then reopen the booking
Compare the wallet, booking and steward record after confirmation
PWA-141.expected: The delivery and any agreed split or return reconcile to the original booking amount. Held value is not also available to spend; receipt history remains visible.

AGT-003.scenario: Independently review chat-submitted Work and verify the reporter’s result
preconditions: AGT-002 published Work
Independent steward outside the contributor roster; authorized review
Required participants: steward and reporter.
steps: Find the same Work and evidence in the cockpit
Approve or reject with feedback and wait for confirmation
As the reporter, read the resulting status in chat and the app
AGT-003.expected: The independent review and feedback agree across chat, app and cockpit. A Work receipt is not confused with review approval or payout.

AGT-002.scenario: Correct a report and publish one Work through browser authorization
preconditions: AGT-001 paired member; authorized test submission
Disposable text, photo, voice and document samples; only supported evidence is accepted
Required participants: reporter.
steps: Create a report, attach supported media and correct the action, description or garden before confirmation
Open the browser authorization and reject signing once
Retry, confirm and wait for the receipt; open the resulting Work in the app
AGT-002.expected: The review matches the corrected report and accepted evidence. Unsupported input is explained. Rejection sends nothing; confirmed submission publishes one Work under the paired account, never an automatic approval.

ROLL-002.scenario: In progress: choose the explicit exchange pool and reconcile the receipt
preconditions: Activation gate: use only the explicitly scoped rollout build and reviewed deployment; this case is not evidence that the feature has shipped.
Reviewed issuer-desk revision; two configured garden exchange pools; authorized test funds
Required participants: member and steward.
steps: Choose the destination pool and inspect the route, asset and terms
Reject a wrong or unavailable route, then submit the approved route
Reload during receipt lookup and reconcile the known operation
ROLL-002.expected: Only the explicitly selected reviewed pool is used. Unavailable routes cannot send; reload never duplicates exchange or approval, and the receipt records the actual pool.

QA-002.scenario: Converge two devices and recover an offline verdict
preconditions: QA-001 signed-in tester on two devices; second tester on a different case
Required participants: allowlisted QA tester.
steps: Change a verdict on one device and its note on the other
Go offline, edit another note and reload
Reconnect and compare both devices and the other tester’s record
QA-002.expected: Field changes converge without overwriting confirmed edits or another tester. Offline changes remain local with an honest unsaved message and sync once into their original open run.

ROLL-007.scenario: In progress: rehearse migration atomically and reconcile each garden’s two jars
preconditions: Activation gate: use only the explicitly scoped rollout build and reviewed deployment; this case is not evidence that the feature has shipped.
Pinned pre-migration fork and reviewed manifest of every garden and asset pair
No live broadcast; use the owning migration rehearsal and direct adapter tests
Required participants: release operator.
steps: Snapshot legacy registry, balances, roles and yield destinations
Rehearse legacy unlisting and pair provisioning; inject a second-asset failure and changed Hat/factory inputs
Retry from the unchanged fixture and read both registry entries, factory identities and yield destinations
ROLL-007.expected: A failed pair leaves neither partial deployment nor partial registration. Changed roles, factory or existing entries reject stale calldata. Successful pairs map the intended assets; old history is retained and active new jars cannot be unlisted as legacy.

ADM-201.scenario: Request steward access and remain unprivileged while pending
preconditions: Signed-in requester without steward access; eligible garden; enabled request API
Required participants: requester.
steps: Choose the garden from the no-access screen and review the request
Cancel signing once, then sign and submit
Reload and open a protected garden route
ADM-201.expected: Cancellation creates no request. A submitted request is pending for the chosen garden; it grants no role and protected actions remain unavailable.

ROLL-005.scenario: In progress: operate limits within policy and enforce role loss
preconditions: Activation gate: use only the explicitly scoped rollout build and reviewed deployment; this case is not evidence that the feature has shipped.
Reviewed Hats jar pair on a test garden; owner, steward, gardener and unrelated accounts
Required participants: owner and steward.
steps: Inspect and change operational limits as each role
Try exceeding the policy ceiling, shortening cooldown and exceeding daily budget
Revoke the acting role before confirmation and retry; inspect legacy jars separately
ROLL-005.expected: Only the designated role can act within policy. Limits, cooldown and budget reject boundary violations; role loss is rechecked. Legacy and new jars retain their distinct permission rules.

PWA-145.scenario: Sign after passkey recovery and keep account switching isolated
preconditions: PWA-144 completed on the same supported origin
One small test Work submission or other explicitly authorized account operation
A second account and an unsent item on the original device
steps: Reject the first signing prompt, then retry the authorized operation
Wait for its receipt and verify the original account is the author
Switch accounts, reload, and return to the original account
PWA-145.expected: Rejected signing sends nothing. The retry lands once under the recovered account. The other account cannot see, send or discard the original account’s unsent items; returning restores them.

ROLL-001.scenario: In progress: revise an issuer draft and obtain fresh member approval
preconditions: Activation gate: use only the explicitly scoped rollout build and reviewed deployment; this case is not evidence that the feature has shipped.
Issuer-desk rollout enabled; issuer and authorized reviewer with disposable draft
Required participants: issuer and steward.
steps: Create and review a draft with terms and proposed pool
Approve one revision, then change a material term
Attempt activation with the old approval, then review the current revision
ROLL-001.expected: Revision history is retained. Old approval cannot authorize changed terms; activation remains gated until the exact current revision and authorities are approved.

QA-001.scenario: Authenticate and save one private verdict across reload
preconditions: Hosted QA app; allowlisted tester and a non-allowlisted wallet
Disposable run; record its environment, catalog revision and build under test
Required participants: allowlisted QA tester.
steps: Try sign-in with the non-allowlisted wallet, then cancel and complete allowed sign-in
Record a verdict and note in the disposable run
Wait for saved confirmation, reload and read the same case
QA-001.expected: Unauthorized access is refused and cancellation is retryable. The allowed tester’s verdict and note persist in the intended run without exposing private data publicly.

PWA-140.scenario: Approve service terms and book the agreed amount
preconditions: Enabled service-voucher deployment and a test service with agreed terms
Member and independent steward; test funds and the write boundary explicitly authorized
steps: Open the service promise and review issuer, unit, amount and terms
Cancel once, then approve the current terms and book
Wait for the receipt and open the booking from Your Wallet
PWA-140.expected: Cancel sends nothing. One booking uses the approved terms and amount; its held balance and wallet link agree. A pending receipt is not shown as completed.

QA-003.scenario: Roll over with unsaved edits and preserve closed-run history
preconditions: Disposable QA run; two testers; one live unsaved edit and one outbox recovered after reload
Required participants: allowlisted QA tester.
steps: Have both testers start the successor run at nearly the same time
Read the outcome and the handling of live versus recovered unsent edits
Open the closed run and compare it with the successor
QA-003.expected: Exactly one successor is open. Closed history cannot be edited; live edits explain their new destination and recovered old-run edits wait for an explicit decision. No verdict silently moves to another run.

ADM-205.scenario: Resolve a service booking with the approved terms and amount
preconditions: Enabled service-voucher deployment and a test service with agreed terms
Member and independent steward; test funds and the write boundary explicitly authorized
PWA-140 booking awaiting authorized delivery resolution
steps: Open the booking from the voucher console
Review its terms and proposed delivery, split or return
Cancel once, then confirm the agreed outcome and wait for the receipt
ADM-205.expected: Only the authorized steward can resolve it. Cancel changes nothing; the confirmed outcome conserves the booked amount and is visible to the member without claiming payment from Work approval alone.

PWA-144.scenario: Recover an older passkey account without changing its identity
preconditions: Older passkey account with its original address recorded privately
Hosted supported origin; a second browser or device with the passkey available through the intended Apple or Google account
steps: Sign out and recover by the existing account name on a browser without local account storage
Compare the recovered address, memberships and balances with the original
Reload, sign out and recover again on each supported origin in scope
PWA-144.expected: Recovery opens the original account, with the same address and memberships. A different origin or unavailable passkey gives an honest recovery path and never silently creates a replacement account.

service-relay.label: Service relay: Green Goods → Garden → members
service-relay.summary: Two people follow a protocol Request from the Green Goods pool through garden delivery, then use a separate garden commitment to recognize the member's work. Both commitments are the garden-work type: each becomes ready through approved linked Work, not through evidence and Send for Confirmation.

protocol-review.label: Protocol & review
protocol-review.role: Protocol steward and independent steward or evaluator of the test garden; never a contributor

garden-member.label: Garden & member
garden-member.role: Steward and member of the test garden; institutional claimant, accountable lead, and contributor

ADM-037.handoff: Wait until the garden member can see the starting assessment.

ADM-038.handoff: Both people confirm the same garden and open cycle are visible; the assessment is context, not a prerequisite.

ADM-139.handoff: Wait until the Request appears in the protocol pool for the garden member.

PWA-047.handoff: The protocol reviewer waits for the pending garden claim before accepting it.

ADM-040.handoff: Both people verify the Request remains in the protocol pool and names the garden as provider.

PWA-048.handoff: The reviewer waits until the linked Work and evidence are visible before deciding.

ADM-042.handoff: Both people verify the approved Request is Fulfilled before moving to compensation.

ADM-043.handoff: The garden member verifies the destination Garden Safe or its readiness state.
ADM-043.knownGate: Protocol-to-Garden G$ settlement requires enabled settlement UI and value authority. If either is unavailable, record Blocked and continue with the non-value steps.

ADM-140.handoff: Seed it as Garden work with one action row, so the member's Work can link to it. Wait until the separate local commitment appears in the open garden Campaign.

PWA-050.handoff: The reviewer waits for the local Work and evidence before opening review.

ADM-145.handoff: Both people verify the local commitment is complete and remains distinct from the protocol Request.

ADM-044.handoff: The garden member verifies the receiving account or the visible readiness state.
ADM-044.knownGate: Garden-to-member G$ settlement requires enabled contributor payout UI and value authority. If either is unavailable, record Blocked without changing the completed non-value workflow.

protocol-treasury-top-up.label: Protocol treasury top-up
protocol-treasury-top-up.summary: Check discretionary funding readiness, queue a ProtocolToGarden top-up when authorized, and verify the garden balance without referencing a commitment.

protocol-review.label: Protocol & review
protocol-review.role: Protocol steward with authority to inspect and, when approved, queue treasury funding

garden-member.label: Garden & member
garden-member.role: Test-garden steward who verifies the destination garden and its balance

ADM-045.handoff: The garden steward verifies the destination garden and balance; no commitment ID is involved.
ADM-045.knownGate: Protocol treasury funding requires explicit value authority and a live ProtocolToGarden funding path. If unavailable, record Blocked and do not imply that funds moved.

service-vouchers.label: Service booking: member, steward and wallet
service-vouchers.summary: Walk an enabled service booking through approval, delivery and balance reconciliation. Confirm the deployment and write boundary first; record missing prerequisites as Blocked, never as a completed exchange.

steward.label: Steward
steward.role: Independent steward authorized to resolve this booking

PWA-140.handoff: The steward verifies the booking ID, approved terms, amount and held balance before resolving it.

ADM-205.handoff: The member sees the confirmed resolution on the same booking before checking wallet balances.

PWA-141.handoff: Both people reconcile the same booking with the held, spent and returned voucher amounts.

steward-access.label: Steward access: request, role and cockpit
steward-access.summary: Use separate requester and reviewer accounts. A pending request grants no privileges; verify the confirmed role before entering the cockpit.

ADM-201.handoff: The reviewer sees the pending request for the same account and garden; the requester still has no steward access.

ADM-202.handoff: The requester refreshes and verifies the confirmed role and cockpit access in the intended garden.

telegram-reporting.label: Telegram report: consent, Work and independent review
telegram-reporting.summary: Use the enabled Telegram adapter and private disposable evidence. Browser authorization, Work publication and independent review are separate outcomes; unavailable services remain Blocked.

reviewer.label: Reviewer
reviewer.role: Independent steward outside the contributor roster

AGT-002.handoff: The independent reviewer finds the same published Work and evidence in the cockpit before reviewing.

AGT-003.handoff: The reporter sees the confirmed review result for the same Work in both chat and the app.

passkey-continuity.label: Passkey recovery: same account, then a signed operation
passkey-continuity.summary: Walk on the supported hosted origins and real device families in scope. Virtual authenticators and local substitutes do not prove account recovery on a real device.

member.label: Member
member.role: Owner of the older passkey account

qa-recording.label: QA operations: saved verdicts and run rollover
qa-recording.summary: Use a disposable run and private notes. Confirm the catalog revision and builds, then prove recording and rollover with two devices.

QA-002.handoff: Both devices show the confirmed verdict and note; the peer verifies that their own entry remains independent.

QA-003.handoff: Both testers identify the new open run and read the closed run; recovered old outbox entries remain parked.

rollout-service-issuer.label: In progress: issuer revision and exchange
rollout-service-issuer.summary: Rollout readiness only. Do not count these steps as shipped coverage or activation approval. Confirm the reviewed deployment, issuer revision and allowed value boundary first.

steward.label: Steward
steward.role: Reviewer of the issuer and destination pool

ROLL-001.handoff: The reviewer verifies the current issuer revision and fresh approval before any exchange is prepared.

ROLL-002.handoff: Both people reconcile the selected pool and receipt, keeping this result in the rollout run.

rollout-hats-jars.label: In progress: Hats jar migration and permissions
rollout-hats-jars.summary: Rollout readiness only. Rehearse on a pinned fork before an authorized staging walk. A passing rehearsal does not authorize a live migration or certify every garden.

operator.label: Release operator
operator.role: Operator of the reviewed migration rehearsal

steward.label: Steward
steward.role: Garden steward with separately verified role authority

ROLL-007.handoff: The steward verifies both asset mappings and the rollback evidence before walking the staged jar controls.

ROLL-005.handoff: The operator verifies policy limits, budget and revoked-role rejection on the same reviewed jar pair.

ROLL-006.handoff: Both people verify the applied policy, pause state and approved recovery destination without inferring fleet activation.
